name: Mirma
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Mirma is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Shaharaim, a Benjamite. He was born in the land of Moab after Shaharaim had sent away his former wives. Mirma is primarily known through his place in the genealogy of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Mirma is listed as one of the sons of Shaharaim and his wife Hodesh, born in the land of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Shaharaim's Family in Moab
keyEvents.description: Mirma's father Shaharaim had children in the land of Moab after he sent away his wives Hushim and Baara, and took Hodesh as a new wife.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Mirma belongs to the tribe of Benjamin, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and his lineage is documented in the genealogies of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of Benjamin Compiled
keyEvents.description: The books of Chronicles gather detailed genealogical records of the tribes of Israel, including the tribe of Benjamin where Mirma is mentioned as part of the family branches.
